text: The Hamilton Beach Rice and Hot Cereal cooker works great. It cooked the rice completely without sputtering like .... The Hamilton Beach Rice and Hot Cereal cooker works great.  It cooked the rice completely without sputtering like other rice pots tend to do.  Love the steamer basket, but have yet to use it.  You won't be disappointed with this rice cooker.

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach Digital Programmable Rice Cooker & Food Steamer, 14 Cups Cooked (7 Uncooked) With Steam & Rinse Basket, Stainless Steel (37548)
features: 2-In-1 rice rinser/steam basket: Rice cooker includes steam basket that doubles as a rice rinser makes it easy to rinse rice before cooking to prevent clumping.
Versatile capacity: The rice/hot cereal cooker makes 2–14 cups of cooked rices and grains, hot cereals, steamed vegetables, and more.

Preprogrammed settings: Six different settings on this rice/hot cereal cooker take the guesswork out of cooking. Choose from white rice, quick rice, whole grain, heat/simmer, steam cook, and hot cereals.
One-Pot cooking: Steam seafood, poultry, or vegetables in the steam basket while the rice cooks or use the heat/simmer setting to make your own soups, beans, or flavored pasta mixes.
Make meal planning easier: The delay start feature on rice cooker lets you program cooking up to 11 hours in advance. Automatically shifts to warm setting after cooking to keep food ready to serve.
description: Making a complete and balanced meal in the Hamilton Beach Electric Rice Cooker & Food Steamer is as easy as placing the ingredients in the bowl and turning it on. Not only does it cook rice and whole grains perfectly, but an integrated basket can be used to steam seafood, poultry and vegetables even while the rice cooks below. That means with just a few presses of a button, it’s quick and easy to serve salmon with kale and quinoa one night and chicken and broccoli over white rice the next. The 2-in-1 steamer basket can also be used to rinse grains before cooking, which prevents clumping and results in a fresher taste. Clean up is a snap with the dishwasher safe nonstick cooking pot. Its compact size makes for easy storage. Cooking healthy, delicious meals doesn’t get any simpler than that. Do not place on or near a hot gas or an electric burner, or in a heated oven.
